summary: One bounded behavior: walk all development artifacts (commits, notes, screenshots, project notes) for leaked hidden content, diff the finished README against section 69, and write a spoiler-safe audit log. Single subsystem (verification and handoff). Dependencies on sibling leaves WI-08a (E2E artifacts) and WI-08c (finished README) are correct for a final-gate audit. Criteria AC-fin-mvp (spoilers half) and AC-fin-spoiler are retained verbatim from parent ST-08 with WI-08b as named final proof owner per the parent's assignment. Evidence is focused (audit log with per-artifact verdict, README diff, recorded statement). Handoff names exact request sections, sibling work items, and concrete actions. Remediation boundary is explicit (dev artifacts in scope, product source via fix-planning route). No hidden scope, no contradictory boundaries.
